blocks.html: Fashionistas and bargain hunters unite for Robinsons Novaliches’ weeklong Fashion Festival happening on August 21 – 27. All fashion items from apparel and shoes to bags and accessories for men, women, kids and teens will be on sale for upto 50% off. Plus, shopaholics get the chance to participate in workshops and tutorials only from the pros of the fashion industry. Fashion Show Are you channeling Jacky O, Audrey Hepburn or Kate Middleton? Watch the Fashion Show on August 21, 1 pm at the Trade Hall and get inspired by its ensemble of budget-friendly yet classy and elegant fashion pieces. Learn to play with plains and prints and know how to achieve a polished look. Retro Fitness Women are into Zumba as they are into clothes. What is better than having to shed off some calories while dancing to retro music on August 22, 4 pm at the Trade Hall? And what better way to enjoy the vibe than dressing up in your favorite 70s, 80s and 90s outfit. Make Up Tutorial Aside from diamonds, one can say that cosmetics are a girl’s bestfriend. It’s not enough that you get the right shade of foundation or buy that matte lipstick you’ve always wanted. It is also essential to know the basics in applying makeup and learning different ways on how to enhance your facial features. On August 23, 1 pm at the Trade Hall, makeup professionals MJ Praz, Russel Navia and Mike Diangca will demonstrate day and evening makeup as well as the basics in contouring. Freebies are also up for grabs during the workshop. Fashion Styling and Modeling A crash course on fashion styling and modeling will be conducted on August 23, 3pm at the Trade Hall by Mode Elle for the aspiring fashion stylists and supermodels. Mode Elle is one of the country’s premier fashion houses and academy for modeling, acting, singing, dancing, personality development, makeup and photography. Mode Elle Founder Rey Allen Castillo will teach wardrobe styling based on a woman’s specific body type and choosing the right pieces for different occasions. For the Karlie Kloss, Kendall Jenner and Gigi Hadid wannabes, there will also be a series of sessions to be conducted on how to project in front of the camera; how to have proper posture; and how to walk the runway. Shopping Spree Want to score a shopping spree at Robinsons Novaliches? Simply post your OOTD in the mall from August 17-25 and use the hashtag #FashionFestivalAtRobinsonsNova on Facebook. Two winners shall be announced on August 26. Celebrity Show Cap off the weeklong fashion fest with the fashionista stars of the hit Kapamilya show Doble Kara on August 27, 5 pm at the Trade Hall. Be updated with the latest trends and fashion events and activities in Robinsons Malls. Visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or follow Robinsons Malls in Facebook; @RobinsonsMalls in Twitter and @robinsonsmallsofficial in Instagram.
